_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Finance-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching mechanism, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

issue_failure_class_map._basis: GROUNDED: each mapping uses the Finance issue's OWN text (canonical circuit detail and/or summary, quoted in finance_text) plus the document's Part XIV named class. No new class was invented. Where the issue text names a mechanism with no analog among the 9 classes, it is marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit.

BANKING_CRISIS.finance_text: canonical circuit GP[Hypo]: "basal-ganglia output gate — lock (bradykinetic freeze)"; summary: "credit intermediation function freezes... The real economy loses access to credit"
BANKING_CRISIS.reasoning: The named mechanism is an OUTPUT GATE stuck in lock (freeze). A gate stuck closed producing downstream starvation is the GATING_FAILURE archetype (gate stuck closed -> starvation), matching Energy's gating-relay stuck-closed mapping.
BANKING_CRISIS.note: Summary also carries a secondary cascade element ('Bank failures cascade through interbank lending networks'); classed on the primary node cue (gate lock), which is the dominant mechanism named.

MARKET_CRASH.finance_text: canonical circuit BLA[Hyper]: "threat learning/acquisition — over-fear=PTSD"; summary: "Panic selling overwhelms market-making capacity, liquidity evaporates, and price discovery breaks down"
MARKET_CRASH.reasoning: Over-fear (excessive threat drive) plus panic selling that OVERWHELMS market-making (the damping/inhibitory capacity) is recurrent runaway exceeding insufficient inhibition = the SEIZURE archetype (no-brakes -> runaway).
MARKET_CRASH.note: Straddles DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (PTSD = failed extinction/brake). Classed as SEIZURE by the 'panic overwhelms capacity' runaway outcome the summary names.

CURRENCY_COLLAPSE.subtype: brake-fail -> rogue runaway (loss of the stop/brake)
CURRENCY_COLLAPSE.finance_text: canonical circuit vmPFC[Hypo]: "top-down inhibitory brake — brake-fail=rogue"; summary: "Rapid devaluation... Capital flight, hyperinflation, and import collapse"
CURRENCY_COLLAPSE.reasoning: The named mechanism is explicitly the loss of the top-down INHIBITORY BRAKE ('brake-fail=rogue'). Losing the inhibitor and releasing rogue/runaway activity is the exact DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME definition (loss of the stop/brake). Strongest grounding of the set.
CURRENCY_COLLAPSE.note: Mirrors Energy's NUCLEAR_INCIDENT 'no-stop' -> DISINHIBITION mapping; here the cue names the brake directly.

CREDIT_FREEZE.finance_text: canonical circuit GP[Hypo]: "basal-ganglia output gate — lock (bradykinetic freeze)"; summary: "Systemic seizure of lending activity. Banks refuse to extend credit... grinds to a halt"
CREDIT_FREEZE.reasoning: Same output-gate lock as BANKING_CRISIS: the credit gate stuck closed starves the real economy of credit = GATING_FAILURE (gate stuck closed -> starvation).
CREDIT_FREEZE.note: The summary word 'seizure' here is colloquial ('seize up / freeze'), i.e. a LOCK, not the electrical SEIZURE class. The governing mechanism cue is 'output gate — lock', hence GATING_FAILURE, not SEIZURE.

SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION.subtype: cross-graph cascade -> network is the unit of failure
SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION.finance_text: summary: "Failure cascading across interconnected financial institutions. One institution's collapse triggers counterparty losses that exceed capital buffers of connected institutions, producing domino-effect failures"; canonical circuit CeA[Hyper]: "phasic fear output — hair-trigger=false-alarm"
SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION.reasoning: The summary is definitionally the DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS class: failure propagates across the graph and the network (not the node) is the unit of failure. Domino/contagion across interconnected institutions maps one-to-one.
SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION.note: Classed on the SUMMARY. The canonical NODE cue ('hair-trigger=false-alarm') points instead at a salience false-alarm (a different flavor); this divergence between node cue and summary is flagged, not resolved by guessing.

FRAUD_SCANDAL.reason: Issue text names a mechanism with NO analog among the 9 Part XIV classes.
FRAUD_SCANDAL.finance_text: canonical circuit OFC[Hyper]: "outcome valuation / update — confabulation"; summary: "Major financial fraud uncovered, destroying market trust and revealing systemic failures in accounting, auditing, and regulatory oversight"
FRAUD_SCANDAL.reasoning: 'Confabulation' and 'fraud' describe an INFORMATION-INTEGRITY / adversarial-deception failure: fabricated valuations and deliberately corrupted signals. The 9 Part XIV classes are all dynamical-failure archetypes (excitation, inhibition, gating, clearance, synchrony, propagation); none expresses fabricated-content or deception. Forcing it into any of the 9 would be a guess. Marked UNMAPPED per discipline.
FRAUD_SCANDAL.note: This is the KEY HETEROGENEITY FINDING. Finance carries a failure archetype (deception/fraud) that Energy did not, and that the E/I-dynamics neuro-substrate taxonomy structurally cannot represent.

incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._test: Part XIV: does each issue's authored circuit contain a regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner from the REGULATORY_NODES set in energy-neuro-substrate.js (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM)? Run against finance.json _authored circuits, matching the JS validateIncompleteCircuit() behavior (uses _authored node list).
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._verdict_summary: PASS (6/6). Every authored circuit includes at least one regulatory/feedback node; none is a bare excitatory driver without its brake. Same headline result as Energy (6/6). NOTE: two issues (MARKET_CRASH, SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION) have CANONICAL single-node circuits (BLA, CeA) that are bare non-regulatory nodes and WOULD fail the test in isolation; the _authored multi-node circuits supply the regulatory partner.

MARKET_CRASH.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is BLA[Hyper] alone (a threat-acquisition node, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies OFC/dlPFC/dACC brakes.

SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is CeA[Hyper] alone (phasic fear output, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies dACC/dlPFC.

FRAUD_SCANDAL.observation: Circuit is complete (dACC oversight + OFC valuation present), yet the issue is UNMAPPED in the failure-class map: a circuit can be structurally complete under the incomplete-circuit test and still express a failure archetype (fraud/confabulation) outside the 9-class taxonomy. The two diagnostics are independent.

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Finance mapping must preserve an analogous fast-action / slow-governance separation, or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
